findings.description: imageUpload.ts line 32 reads `urlData.publicUrl` but the API returns `{ data: { publicUrl } }`, so this is undefined. Change to `const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage.from('school-images').getPublicUrl(filePath);` and then `return { success: true, url: publicUrl };`.
Admin.tsx uses `<ImageUpload>` at line 313 but never imports it from '../components/ImageUpload'. Add the import.
Admin.tsx line 306 destructures `uploadAndUpdateImage` from `useData()`, but line 20 only destructures `images`. Add `uploadAndUpdateImage` to the destructuring at line 20.

ImageUpload shows error messages without aria-live regions. Screen readers won't announce upload failures until the user navigates to the message. Add `aria-live="polite"` to the error message div at ImageUpload.tsx line 151.

findings.issue: RLS allows any authenticated user to upload
findings.description: Storage policies gate uploads on `auth.role() = 'authenticated'` but don't verify the user is a school admin. Any authenticated Supabase user can upload. Acceptable if this project is dedicated to the school; a security hole if the project is shared or might have non-admin users.
